data.title: 中野一花 · 后台更衣室的闭门心跳
data.description: 更衣室内暖光柔和，一花背靠着紧闭的房门，食指轻抵唇间示意噤声。面对近在咫尺的少年，大姐姐也忍不住耳根泛红心跳加速。
data.action: leaning against mirror, finger on lips, blushing heavily
data.lighting: warm ambient lamp glow and mirror reflections
data.promptProse: Inside a private backstage fitting room behind drawn velvet curtains, Nakano Ichika leans back against the illuminated mirror. Her cheeks flush with a deep, shy blush as she touches her lower lip with her fingertip, staring closely into the viewer's eyes.
data.animaCaption: Back against the closed dressing room door, she brings a finger to her parted lips with a breathless blush.
